summary: Large insurance platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated/Private for realtime claims chat + reranking. Primary focus: firm throughput guarantees for nightly reconciliation, strict latency SLOs for chat threads, and a commercial SLA that protects business-critical settlement windows.
sla_requirements: Uptime target: 99.95% tracked monthly with independent metrics feed
Credit schedule: 5% monthly credit for 99.90-99.95, 15% for 99.50-99.90, 50% for <99.50
Support response: P1 30 minutes, P2 4 hours, P3 24 hours (business hours defined)
Maintenance windows: prefer rolling maintenance outside 02:00-06:00 local (no windows during settlement 00:00-04:00 UTC for NA accounts)
Planned maintenance notifications: min 72 hours, emergency maintenance follow-up within 4 hours
Data residency: EU-subset must remain in EU dedicated cluster when requested
SLA carveouts: agreed maintenance count < 4/year; vendor must provide fallback routing plan
technical_requirements: Reserved GPU planning: baseline 8xA100 equivalent GPU capacity with burst pool up to +50%
Throughput guarantees: baseline 1M tokens/hour sustained per shard, autoscale latency cap at p95 150ms
Latency SLOs: chat p95 <120ms steady-state; reranking median <80ms
KV cache and prefix caching required for high-QPS chat sessions
Model variants: primary fp16 quantized, fallback cheaper quantized variant for degraded mode
Observability: token-level cost, per-request trace id, retention 90 days logs
